info.title: Environment Studio hosted v3 plans
info.description: Twenty-three fixed-v3 routes including semantic commands, explicit materialization, document inventory, physical entities, structural decisions, binding pages, document comparison, complete locations and computed groups/contributors. Actual compiler publication remains incomplete; test publication witnesses do not qualify runtime availability. See hosted-plan-http-v3.md, hosted-plan-commands-v3.md, hosted-plan-materialization-v3.md hosted-plan-physical-views-v3.md hosted-plan-structural-views-v3.md hosted-plan-document-views-v3.md and hosted-plan-computed-views-v3.md for original session authority, shared admission, bounded transfers and early no-body controller refusals. No export or readback endpoint is provided.

post.summary: Capture verified original physical-only schema3 profile
post.description: See hosted-plan-workflow-v3.md. Original V3 owner, full view admission and the shared semantic transfer precede input; original authority and full proofs remain checked through owned output (128 MiB, original 30 seconds). The closed capture body permits 64 MiB under the original 30-second clock and requires a complete physical mapping of the original observation, at most 20000 entries, with explicit value-free slot IDs and labels. Capture returns physical-only schema 3 JSON source, at most 1 MiB UTF8, with its exact definition reference. Capture does not save or publish a profile; use the existing workspace draft/history APIs explicitly.

200.description: Owned complete result or explicit computed-rule page; no export authority

post.summary: Inspect full qualified v3 profile closure and affected derivations
post.description: See hosted-plan-workflow-v3.md. Original V3 owner, full view admission and the shared semantic transfer precede input; original authority and full proofs remain checked through owned output (128 MiB, original 30 seconds). The closed preview body permits 64 MiB under the original 30-second clock. Whole or selected physical roots yield complete freshly qualified versioned dependencies and pins, plus all affected derivations. Page sections are included, dependencies, relations or conflicts; offset 0..50000 and limit 1..100. All pages share the complete preview digest and pins. Apply explicit conflict, value and placement choices through the existing compose-profile command; donor values are never imported.

200.description: Owned complete result or explicit computed-rule page; no export authority

post.summary: Evaluate complete v3 validation and inspect fingerprint-bound rule pages
post.description: See hosted-plan-workflow-v3.md. Original V3 owner, full view admission and the shared semantic transfer precede input; original authority and full proofs remain checked through owned output (128 MiB, original 30 seconds). The closed validation body permits 16 KiB under the original 10-second clock. A revision-only request returns complete checks, physical rules, target completeness and nullable computed-rule count without the full computed-rule array. Computed-rule page requests require the exact validation inputFingerprint, offset 0..2147483647 and limit 1..100. Fingerprint mismatch refuses CONFLICT; missing target refuses INCOMPLETE_TARGET. An oversized page refuses RESOURCE_LIMIT; request fewer rows at the same offset and fingerprint. Counts remain complete and cardinalities are exact decimal strings. Export remains unavailable.

200.description: Owned complete result or explicit computed-rule page; no export authority

post.summary: Acknowledge exact checked v3 plan inputs without granting export
post.description: See plan-review-v3.md. Original V3 lease/view and shared semantic transfer precede input. Closed 16 KiB body under original 10-second deadline; 32 KiB acknowledgement under original 30-second output deadline. Fresh publication and complete XML proof bind exact fingerprint, destination and protected-self-contained intent. Shared 256-entry replay is checked before current revision pinning and never reactivates review. Original async abort is atomically ordered before commit; response loss after commit preserves the historical receipt. Review and immutable whole-document policy checks do not qualify client capability or authorize export.

200.description: Original unchanged-revision receipt; no operationId or export authority

currentComputedCounts.description: Null means no complete retained partition; a present all-zero object is an empty complete partition.

targetComputedCounts.description: Null means no complete retained partition; a present all-zero object is an empty complete partition.

ComputedCounts.description: One computed partition. Java separately enforces the shared physical-plus-computed graph limits.

Error400.description: Malformed or unknown request fields; an early controller refusal has no body and includes Content-Length: 0 plus X-Environment-Studio-Code together. The closed-code header denotes that branch and requires zero length. Other branches may also carry a nonzero Content-Length. An owned transfer or security middleware may instead return its documented JSON error body.
